title: NOVATEK Capture — Experience Spine
summary: Behavioural experience specification for the NOVATEK Capture phone PWA: information architecture, governed sentences, component and state contracts, offline queue semantics, accessibility floor and key flows.
scope: NOVATEK Capture PWA (single route, fifteen surfaces)
Governed sentences (lib/copy/governed.ts) and the Honesty Surface
Ribbon, header and connectivity badge
Gate and persona sessions
Order list and order detail
Clock control and Time on this order
Photograph screen (verifying / gathering evidence states) and viewfinder/shutter
Verify result and authored verification
Spoken note, photo strip and record control
Proposals screen, proposal card, grade marks and accept/reject in-place confirm
Decision state and decision context (FR-59)
Referral flow, referral entry bar and unresolved-referral states
Sync screen, offline queue, queue states, conflict and reject codes
What Walk receives payload (five sets, arrived_via, negative fields, store self-description)
Limits screen and claims disposition table
Desktop frame and responsive breakpoints
PWA install, caching, storage persistence and iOS/Android platform differences
State marks (closed set of seven) and tri-source connectivity
Accessibility floor (WCAG 2.2 AA, SC 2.5.5, SC 1.4.6, focus management, 200% text)
Voice and tone rules and claims audit (scripts/claims-audit.mjs)
Key flows UJ-1 through UJ-5
